title: Network Engineer – AWS & Cisco Migration
description:
Description: 
 Network Engineer – AWS & Cisco Migration 
 Requirements: 
 Role Summary 
We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer with deep expertise in Cisco networking technologies and AWS cloud networking to lead and execute the migration of onpremises and Ciscobased network infrastructure into AWS. This role will be responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating hybrid and cloudnative network architectures while modernizing legacy Cisco environments.
The ideal candidate has handson experience with Cisco firewalls, routing/switching, VPNs, and BGP, combined with strong practical knowledge of AWS VPC design, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and cloud security controls.   Required Qualifications 7+ years of professional experience as a Network Engineer, with strong Cisco networking background. 3+ years of handson experience designing and supporting AWS networking. Deep expertise in Cisco routing and switching, including BGP and OSPF. Strong experience with Cisco firewalls (ASA, FTD, ASAv/FTDv) and VPN technologies. Solid understanding of AWS VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, and Elastic Load Balancing. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex network issues in production environments. Experience migrating largescale enterprise networks from Cisco to AWS. Handson experience with Terraform (preferred) or CloudFormation. Familiarity with container networking (EKS, Kubernetes CNI). AWS and/or Cisco certifications such as:
- AWS Advanced Networking – Specialty
- CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Security 
 Job Responsibilities: 
 Cisco to AWS Migration Lead network migration initiatives from Cisco onpremises and datacenter environments to AWS. Assess existing Cisco architectures (ASA/FTD, routers, switches) and define migration strategies to AWSnative or virtualized equivalents (ASAv/FTDv, Transit Gateway, AWS Network Firewall). Migrate and validate ACLs, NAT rules, VPNs (SitetoSite and Client VPN), and routing policies in AWS. AWS Networking & Hybrid Connectivity Design and implement AWS VPC architectures, including CIDR planning, subnets, routing tables, gateways (IGW/NAT), and security boundaries. Build and operate hybrid connectivity using SitetoSite VPN and AWS Direct Connect with BGP and high availability. Implement Transit Gateway architectures for largescale, multiaccount environments. Network Security & Compliance Deploy and manage Cisco firewalls (ASA, FTD, ASAv/FTDv) and/or AWSnative security services. Implement network security best practices using security groups, NACLs, and logging (VPC Flow Logs). Support compliance initiatives (SOC, PCI, HIPAA where applicable) through secure network design and documentation. Automation, Operations & Troubleshooting Use Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation) to standardize and automate network deployments. Troubleshoot complex network issues across Layer 3–7 in hybrid and cloud environments. Leverage AWS tooling such as Reachability Analyzer, CloudWatch, and traffic monitoring to ensure network reliability. Create and maintain architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational documentation. 
 What We Offer: 
 Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities! Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
